basis: Southeasternmost room = L-shaped office bounded on south/east by exterior wall (outside face used: east x=611px, south y=876px) and on west/north by thin interior partitions represented by single centerline (west partition x=403px separating from dining room; north jog wall at y=600px/x=557px/y=700px separating from room above). Two door apertures traced as jamb-to-jamb gaps in the wall line (arcs/leaves excluded): a door in the north jog wall (jambs x=592 and x=557 at y=700) to the room above, and a door in the west partition (jambs y=841 and y=874 at x=403) to the dining room. A south-wall cyan hatch near x=537-592 was checked but shows no swing arc, so it is treated as a window, not a door, and excluded from apertures.
